name: Pirate Metrics (AARRR) Baseline Funnel Audit
phase: Metrics, Telemetry, and Innovation Accounting Tactics
hypothesis: We believe that our product funnel converts prospects efficiently from initial discovery through to paid renewal. We will verify this by instrumenting end-to-end event telemetry across all five funnel stages, and consider it validated if we achieve baseline conversions of ≥ 20% Acquisition-to-Activation and ≥ 5% Activation-to-Revenue.
schematic: Read at stage 5 of the 5-stage funnel

plan.label: Preparation
plan.text: Define one metric per stage: landing visitor, value moment, 7-day return, payment executed, invite dispatched.

plan.label: Execution
plan.text: Instrument an analytics event for each step on an open-source analytics or warehouse platform.

plan.label: Data collection
plan.text: Build the funnel view and track conversion percentage and velocity between successive steps.

planFull.label: Preparation
planFull.text: Define operational metrics for each funnel step: Acquisition (unique landing visitor), Activation (core value moment reached), Retention (return usage within 7 days), Revenue (payment executed), and Referral (invite dispatched).

planFull.label: Execution
planFull.text: Instrument analytics events for each operational step using an open-source product analytics or data warehouse platform.

planFull.label: Data collection
planFull.text: Build a conversion funnel visualization, tracking conversion percentages and user velocity between successive steps.

warning.label: Blended Funnel Distortions
warning.text: One blended average hides channel differences: weak paid traffic dilutes strong organic intent.

warningFull: Evaluating the funnel as a single, blended average hides performance differences across individual traffic channels, masking the fact that poor paid traffic is diluting strong organic engagement.
